title: Room climate setting of one measure (area page)

value.description: The room value the apps show now (rule applied to the live states); null = none.

unit.description: unit_of_measurement of the first entity the value comes from (a thermostat: % for humidity, null for temperature).

name.description: Display name of the placement, else friendly_name, else entity_id.

tier.description: device = thermostat (device_domains, first tier), sensor = sensor of the device class.

in_room.description: The entity, or its device, is assigned to the Home Assistant area of this area (preferred over entities only placed here).

excluded.description: Why it never counts automatically: an exclude group id of data/room-climate.json (fridge, outdoor ...) or entity_category; null = it may count.

value.description: Current value; null = unavailable or not numeric.
